Name: Even Bigger Backpack
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[size=5]🎒 [b]BECAUSE FOUR ROWS STILL WEREN’T ENOUGH![/b] ✨[/size]

Bigger Backpack got you all the way to 48 inventory slots...and somehow you still managed to fill them.

[b]Even Bigger Backpack[/b] is an add-on for [b]Bigger Backpack[/b] that adds one final backpack upgrade, expanding your inventory from [b]48 slots to a glorious 60[/b]. 🎉

Bigger Backpack’s original upgrade stays completely intact. Once you’ve purchased it, simply return to Pierre’s backpack display and throw even more money at your inventory problems.

[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🎒 [b]A fifth inventory row![/b]
Expand your maximum backpack capacity from [b]48 slots to 60 slots[/b].

⬆️ [b]Keeps Bigger Backpack’s original progression![/b]
You’ll still purchase the normal backpack upgrades followed by Bigger Backpack’s 48-slot upgrade before unlocking the final upgrade.

📦 [b]Five-row menu support![/b]
Inventory layouts are adjusted so all 60 slots display properly across supported menus.

🔨 [b]Supports multiple inventory screens![/b]
Includes support for the inventory, crafting, shop, shipping, and museum donation menus.

💰 [b]Configurable upgrade price![/b]
Change the cost of the final backpack upgrade through Generic Mod Config Menu or the generated config file.

[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]🚪 [b]HOW TO START[/b] 🚪[/size]

Purchase Stardew Valley’s normal backpack upgrades and [b]Bigger Backpack’s 48-slot upgrade[/b] first. Once your character has 48 inventory slots, return to Pierre’s General Store and interact with the backpack display again. You’ll be offered the [b]Even Bigger Pack. [/b]The default price is [b]100,000g[/b]
[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]📥 [b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b] 📥[/size]

You’ll need:

🔧 [b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b]

🎒 [b]Bigger Backpack 7.3+[/b]

🛠️ [b]StardewHack[/b]

Once those are installed, extract [b]Even Bigger Backpack[/b] directly into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.

Do [b]not[/b] place Even Bigger Backpack inside the Bigger Backpack folder, overwrite Bigger Backpack, or remove the original mod. Even Bigger Backpack patches the original mod rather than replacing it. 🧩

[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]⚙️ [b]CONFIGURATION[/b] ⚙️[/size]

The purchase price for the final backpack upgrade can be customized.

The default config is:

[code]{
"BackpackCost": 100000
}[/code]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] is optional, but makes changing the price much easier. You can also edit the generated [b]config.json[/b] manually.

[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]⌨️ [b]CONSOLE COMMANDS[/b] ⌨️[/size]

Need to manually change your backpack size? Even Bigger Backpack includes two SMAPI console commands.

🎒 [b]Set your backpack to 60 slots:[/b]

[code]evenbigger_setslots 60[/code]
This expands the current player’s backpack to 60 slots. The player must already own Bigger Backpack’s original 48-slot upgrade.

⬇️ [b]Return your backpack to 48 slots:[/b]

[code]evenbigger_setslots 48[/code]
This safely shrinks your inventory back to 48 slots.

[b]The command will refuse to shrink your backpack if any items are still stored in the fifth row.[/b]

Your parsnips will not be sacrificed for convenience. 🌱

[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]🚨 [b]SAFE REMOVAL[/b] 🚨[/size]

[b]Please do not simply delete the mod while using the 60-slot backpack.[/b]

Before uninstalling:

1️⃣ Empty [b]every slot in the fifth row[/b].

2️⃣ Open the SMAPI console.

3️⃣ Enter:

[code]evenbigger_setslots 48[/code]
4️⃣ Save your game and exit.

5️⃣ Remove the Even Bigger Backpack folder.

[b]Do not uninstall the mod while items are stored in the fifth row.[/b]

Shrink first. Delete second. Keep your stuff. Everybody wins. 💕

[center]🎒━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎒[/center]

[size=4]🧩 [b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b] 🧩[/size]

💻 Designed for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 on desktop[/b].

🎒 Built and tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845?tab=files]Bigger Backpack 7.3[/url].

🗃️ Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43127]UI Info Suite 2 Alternative[/url]

🎮 [b]Multiplayer support[/b]
Multiplayer has not been tested. Installing Even Bigger Backpack for [b]every player[/b] is recommended so everyone’s inventory menus use the same five-row layout.

Because this mod changes several inventory interfaces, mods that heavily redesign or replace those same menus may potentially require compatibility patches.

If you run into a menu that doesn’t quite know what to do with that fifth row, compatibility reports are welcome! 💕
